classification.difficultyReason: Identify corresponding, alternate and co-interior angles and name the relevant parallel lines.

content.prompt: Find the values of the angles $\alpha$, $\beta$, $\gamma$ and $\theta$ in each diagram below. Give careful reasons for all your statements, and name the relevant parallel lines.

spec.description: Two single-arrow parallel lines AB and CD crossed by RU, with intersections T and S; all eight labels retained. Ordinary source blue is rendered black.
spec.mathematics: Angle TSD is 60 degrees; theta is angle UTB; AB parallel CD.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given 60 degrees and unknown theta appear.

answer.worked: $\theta=60^\circ$ because corresponding angles are equal when $AB\parallel CD$.

spec.description: Parallelogram DEFG with single arrows on DE and GF and double arrows on DG and EF.
spec.mathematics: Angle GDE is 120 degrees; theta is angle DEF; DG parallel EF and DE parallel GF.

answer.worked:
Co-interior angles sum to $180^\circ$ because $DG\parallel EF$.
$$\begin{align*}\theta+120^\circ&=180^\circ\\\theta&=60^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Z-shaped diagram with matching arrows on RS and TU and transversal TS.
spec.mathematics: Angle STU is 38 degrees; alpha is angle RST; RS parallel TU.

answer.worked: $\alpha=38^\circ$ because alternate angles are equal when $RS\parallel TU$.

spec.description: Crossed triangular regions with BA horizontal, CD crossing at O, and matching parallel arrows on BD and CA. The source is not drawn to its stated angle measure.
spec.mathematics: Angle ABD is given as 72 degrees; beta is angle BAC; BD parallel CA.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied 72 degrees is retained without adding beta's value.

answer.worked: $\beta=72^\circ$ because alternate angles are equal when $BD\parallel CA$.

spec.description: Triangle AOX with B on AO, Y on OX and parallel-marked BY and AX. Gamma is below BY in angle BYX.
spec.mathematics: Angle AXO is 50 degrees; gamma is angle BYX; BY parallel AX.
spec.answerVisibility: Gamma remains unknown; its label is outside the upper triangle.

answer.worked:
Co-interior angles sum to $180^\circ$ because $BY\parallel AX$.
$$\begin{align*}\gamma+50^\circ&=180^\circ\\\gamma&=130^\circ\end{align*}$$
